summary: Feed s057_single is degraded: 100% of packets are untagged while IDS requires VLANs 10 and 20. No other visibility faults detected (no duplicates, drops, overload, truncation, tunnels, or one-way traffic).

findings.root_cause: Packet broker or upstream TAP/SPAN is stripping 802.1Q tags or delivering via an access/untagged port instead of a trunk. 100% of sampled packets are untagged so required VLANs 10 and 20 are not visible.
findings.impact_on_tool: IDS requires VLANs 10 and 20 for segmentation-aware detection. Without tags it cannot apply VLAN-based policies, correlate traffic to the correct segment, or detect lateral movement between VLANs 10/20 - rules expecting tagged traffic will not fire.

recommended_fix.why: Preserve and forward 802.1Q tags for VLANs 10 and 20 end-to-end from TAP through packet broker to IDS so the IDS receives correctly tagged traffic for accurate detection coverage.
